## What's new: you hear of each new release

- **Claude Code tells you when a new t7kb release is out.** When you open a new session, one line says which version is out and that `/t7kb:setup-or-update` updates t7kb and its skills. You no longer need the plugin's auto-update turned on to hear of one. It asks GitHub once per session, stays silent offline, and setting `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` turns it off.
- No new database: the update downloads only the program. No change to the Radiant bridge or the game watch.
